test_cases.description: Verify the function works when only the strictly required fields are present.
test_cases.name: Minimum Fields Only

test_cases.description: Verify that a new task is created and persisted with only required fields provided.
test_cases.name: Add task with minimal valid fields

test_setup.given: A valid task_create input with minimal required fields (e.g., title: 'Test Task'). Task database is empty.
test_setup.then: A new Task object is returned with a unique ID and the provided fields. Task is saved in the database.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with this input.

test_cases.description: Check that a task is created with all possible optional and required fields.
test_cases.name: Add task with all fields provided

test_setup.given: A valid task_create input containing all allowed fields (e.g., title, description, due_date, priority, status).
test_setup.then: A new Task object is returned containing all provided field values, a unique ID is generated, and task is saved to the database.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with this input.

test_cases.description: Ensure that each added task receives a unique ID even when tasks already exist.
test_cases.name: Add task with unique ID generation

test_setup.given: Database contains existing tasks with IDs 1, 2, 3. task_create input is valid.
test_setup.then: The new Task object is assigned an ID not in [1,2,3] (e.g., 4), and is saved to the database.

test_cases.description: Test that a task can be added when the database file exists but contains an empty list.
test_cases.name: Add task when database file is empty

test_setup.given: Database file exists with empty JSON array []. Valid task_create input provided.
test_setup.then: A new Task object is created with ID 1 (or initial value), and saved to the database.

test_cases.description: Verify function creates a new database file if it does not exist and adds the new task.
test_cases.name: Add task when database file does not exist

test_setup.given: No database file is present. Valid task_create input provided.
test_setup.then: A new database file is created with the new Task as its first entry.

test_cases.description: Ensure function fails or handles gracefully when required fields (e.g., title) are missing in input.
test_cases.name: Add task with missing required field

test_setup.given: task_create input is missing a required field (e.g., title).
test_setup.then: Function raises an error or returns a validation failure.

test_cases.description: Check that the function handles type errors (e.g., title is an integer instead of string).
test_cases.name: Add task with invalid field type

test_setup.given: task_create input has title as 123 instead of a string.
test_setup.then: Function raises a type error or returns a validation failure.

test_cases.description: Verify that tasks with duplicate titles are allowed if not restricted by business rules.
test_cases.name: Add task with duplicate title

test_setup.given: Existing task with title 'Duplicate'. task_create input also has title 'Duplicate'.
test_setup.then: Function creates and saves the task with duplicate title but a unique ID.

test_cases.description: Test the system's ability to handle large string inputs, e.g., very long title or description.
test_cases.name: Add task with extremely large field values

test_setup.given: task_create input has title and description with 10,000+ characters.
test_setup.then: Function creates and saves the task successfully without crashing or truncating data.

test_cases.description: Ensure the function can handle special characters and unicode in input fields.
test_cases.name: Add task with special or unicode characters

test_setup.given: task_create input has title and description with emojis or non-Latin characters.
test_setup.then: Function creates and saves the task preserving all characters.

test_cases.description: Check function's behavior if the database file contains invalid JSON.
test_cases.name: Add task with corrupted database file

test_setup.given: Database file exists but is not valid JSON (e.g., contains random text). Valid task_create input.
test_setup.then: Function raises a file parse error or handles it gracefully (e.g., recreates file or reports error).

test_cases.description: Simulate a situation where writing to the database file (e.g., due to permissions or disk full) fails.
test_cases.name: Add task when database write fails

test_setup.given: Database file is read-only or filesystem is out of space. Valid task_create input.
test_setup.then: Function raises an I/O error or reports failure to save task.

test_cases.description: Ensure function handles null or empty input gracefully.
test_cases.name: Add task with null input

test_setup.given: task_create input is null or empty object.
test_setup.then: Function raises an error or returns a validation failure.

test_cases.description: Test behavior when two tasks are added at the same time (simulating concurrency).
test_cases.name: Add task with concurrent writes

test_setup.given: Two valid task_create inputs submitted nearly simultaneously.
test_setup.then: Both tasks are added, each with a unique ID, and database integrity is preserved.
test_setup.when: add_task is called in parallel by separate processes/threads.

test_cases.description: Verify that all task form fields (title, description, priority, category, due date) are rendered.
test_cases.name: Render All Form Fields

test_setup.given: TaskForm component is mounted with default props.
test_setup.then: Input fields for title, description, priority, category, and due date are present in the DOM.

test_cases.description: Form submission should succeed when all required fields are filled properly.
test_cases.name: Submit With All Valid Fields

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered. User enters valid values for title, description, priority, category, and due date.
test_setup.then: onSubmit is called with all field values.

test_cases.description: Form submission should be prevented if the title field is empty.
test_cases.name: Submit With Empty Title

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered. User leaves the title field empty but fills all other fields.
test_setup.then: onSubmit is not called. Validation error is shown for the title field.

test_cases.description: Form submission should succeed if optional fields (description, category, due date) are empty but title is provided.
test_cases.name: Submit With Empty Optional Fields

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered. User enters a valid title and leaves optional fields blank.
test_setup.then: onSubmit is called with title and empty strings or null for optional fields.

test_cases.description: Form submission should be prevented if the title field contains only whitespace.
test_cases.name: Submit With Whitespace Title

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered. User enters a title containing only spaces.
test_setup.then: onSubmit is not called. Validation error is shown for the title field.

test_cases.description: Changing any input field should update the component's internal state.
test_cases.name: Change Form Fields

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered.
test_setup.then: Corresponding input field values in the component state are updated accordingly.
test_setup.when: User types into title, description, selects a priority, chooses a category, and picks a due date.

test_cases.description: Priority dropdown should display all expected priority options (e.g., Low, Medium, High).
test_cases.name: Priority Field Options

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered.
test_setup.then: All predefined priority options are visible and selectable.
test_setup.when: User opens the priority select field.

test_cases.description: Entering an invalid date format should display a validation error and prevent submission.
test_cases.name: Due Date Validation - Invalid Format

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered. User enters an invalid date format in the due date field.
test_setup.then: onSubmit is not called. Validation error is shown for due date.

test_cases.description: Category dropdown should present all available categories/tags.
test_cases.name: Category Field Options

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered.
test_setup.then: All available categories/tags are displayed and selectable.
test_setup.when: User opens the category select field.

test_cases.description: Form submission should succeed for very long title and description values within allowed limits.
test_cases.name: Submit With Long Title and Description

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered. User enters a title and description each at the maximum allowed length.
test_setup.then: onSubmit is called with the long title and description without errors.

test_cases.description: Form should accept special characters in title, description, and other fields.
test_cases.name: Submit With Special Characters

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered. User enters special characters in all input fields.
test_setup.then: onSubmit is called with all field values containing special characters.

test_cases.description: After a successful submission, the form inputs should reset to their initial state.
test_cases.name: Reset Form On Successful Submit

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered. User fills all fields and submits successfully.
test_setup.then: All form fields are cleared/reset to initial values.
test_setup.when: onSubmit is called and completes successfully.

test_cases.description: Validation errors should be visibly displayed when submission fails due to missing required fields.
test_cases.name: Form Error Display On Failed Validation

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered. User leaves required fields empty.
test_setup.then: Validation errors are displayed near the relevant fields.

test_cases.description: Form submission should be prevented if the due date is in the past.
test_cases.name: Submit With Past Due Date

test_setup.given: TaskForm is rendered. User enters a due date that is before today.
test_setup.then: onSubmit is not called. Validation error is shown for due date.
